g.text: — SoFplus-style mod for the 32-bit Linux Soldier of Fortune binary, delivered as one LD_PRELOAD
Core · one preload, many patched call sites
SoF i386 binary starts · `test.so` injected via `LD_PRELOAD` / `BOX86_LD_PRELOAD`
map spawn / level change · demos and page strings reset
public rcon · remote console over UDP
`util.cpp` `memoryAdjust` · mprotect then write the fixed `0x08…` address
`util.cpp` `createDetour` · jump thunk + trampoline, returns the original
`main.cpp` gold-platinum · 1.07f protocol 33, WON disable, master-list swap
`features/httpdl.cpp` · libcurl fetch on precache, unzip into `base/`
`features/serverlist.cpp` · own GameSpy heartbeat + non-blocking browser replies
`features/detect.cpp` · usercmd + aim validation used by game modes
`game_modes/dm_always.cpp` · deathmatch rule set with every feature on
`strip.cpp` · string-package registry, 97 reserved menu string IDs
`python_api/ppnix.cpp` · `ppnix` module — print, time, cvars, chat, file registration
`python_api/player.cpp` + `entity.cpp` · live player / edict objects for scripts
`python_api/decorators.cpp` · `@event.*` registers callbacks fired from C hooks
`python_api/memory.cpp` · scripted read/write of patched engine memory
**not built:** `netchan_extend.cpp` (absent from makefile) · `src/Game/` is vendored reference only
`~/.loki/sof/c/*.m32` — client menu scripts, served over HTTP
`sof` i386 binary — fixed load layout the patches assume
`base/gamex86.so` — stock game DLL, wrapped and detoured
GameSpy + SoFree master servers — UDP heartbeat and query
X11 + SDL 1.2 — clipboard, video modes, GL driver
i386/ubuntu:20.04 build image — cmake, minizip-ng, CPython 3.8
Box86 / QEMU — emulation used by the server bundle
GameSpy + HTTP sockets and curl handle
